sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast a podcast for you to practice your English listening skills.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客，這是一​​個供您練習英語聽力技能的播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to tell you a story about the bus the other day I was on the bus my friend and I had to get home.
sentences.tc: 今天我想跟大家講一個關於公車的故事，那天我和我的朋友在公車上，我必須回家。

sentences.en: We waited for the bus to come for maybe 10 minutes until.
sentences.tc: 我們等了大概10分鐘巴士才來。

sentences.en: We said no.
sentences.tc: 我們說不。

sentences.en: We'll take the.
sentences.tc: 我們將採取。

sentences.en: We waited another 10 minutes but at that point.
sentences.tc: 我們又等了 10 分鐘，但就在那時。

sentences.en: We had already waited 20 minutes I wasn't waiting any longer.
sentences.tc: 我們已經等了20分鐘了，我不再等了。

sentences.en: We got on the bus.
sentences.tc: 我們上了公車。

sentences.en: Then the driver stopped one more time to pick up a family it was a mother and her two young boys.
sentences.tc: 然後司機又停下來接一家人，那是一位母親和她的兩個小男孩。

sentences.en: They were very short so the two boys could not hold on to any of the handles.
sentences.tc: 它們很短，所以兩個男孩無法握住任何把手。

sentences.en: They were going side to side falling and tripping I told one of the boys hold on to me and one older lady said the same one older lady told the boys.
sentences.tc: 他們從一邊到另一邊跌倒並絆倒，我告訴其中一個男孩扶住我，一位年長的女士也說了同樣的話，一位年長的女士告訴男孩們。

sentences.en: Hold on to me hold on to my sweater so the boy did.
sentences.tc: 抓住我，抓住我的毛衣，男孩也這麼做了。

sentences.en: He grabbed the lady and held her tight.
sentences.tc: 他一把抓住了那位女士，緊緊地抱住了她。

sentences.en: He didn't fall anymore it was a very very nice scene it was a very cute experience.
sentences.tc: 他不再跌倒了，這是一個非常非常好的場景，這是一個非常可愛的體驗。

sentences.en: We all rode like sardines the whole way home and once.
sentences.tc: 我們都像沙丁魚一樣騎著馬一路回家，一次。

sentences.en: We all said goodbye nice to meet you and it was a very nice experience I always have nice experiences on the bus.
sentences.tc: 我們都說了再見，很高興見到你，這是一次非常好的經歷，我在公車上總是有美好的經歷。

sentences.en: I love the beautiful people I can meet every day in my normal daytoday life.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡在日常生活中每天遇到的美麗的人。

sentences.en: I love seeing kind actions and really appreciating all the kind people I meet throughout my days.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡看到善意的行為，也非常感謝我一生中遇到的所有善意的人。

sentences.en: I love being in Mexico where you can see all kinds of nice actions every day without a doubt tell me about a nice experience you've had with complete strangers describe.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡在墨西哥，你每天都可以看到各種美好的行為，毫無疑問，請告訴我你與完全陌生的人所描述的美好經驗。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening let me know.

sentences.en: If you enjoy my bus stories so I can tell you some more bye.

phrases.meaning: 常用說法，可用來表達「want to」這個意思

examples.en: Today I want to tell you a story about the bus the other day I was on the bus my friend and I had to get home.
examples.tc: 今天我想跟大家講一個關於公車的故事，那天我和我的朋友在公車上，我必須回家。

phrases.meaning: 常用說法，可用來表達「one of the」這個意思

examples.en: They were going side to side falling and tripping I told one of the boys hold on to me and one older lady said the same one older lady told the boys.
examples.tc: 他們從一邊到另一邊跌倒並絆倒，我告訴其中一個男孩扶住我，一位年長的女士也說了同樣的話，一位年長的女士告訴男孩們。

phrases.meaning: 常用說法，可用來表達「i love」這個意思

examples.en: I love the beautiful people I can meet every day in my normal daytoday life.
examples.tc: 我喜歡在日常生活中每天遇到的美麗的人。
